semantic_conflict_review.notes: The user's attached adoption contract explicitly resolves behavioral conflicts in favor of current staging for identity, shifts, inventory ownership, visibility separation, fiscal/compliance, and governance.

user_approved_decisions.question_asked: Should PR #25 tenant-local cashier credentials replace DGFY identity?
user_approved_decisions.rationale: DGFY remains primary identity and company access authority; local cashier credentials are prohibited.

user_approved_decisions.question_asked: Which terminal and shift behavior wins?
user_approved_decisions.rationale: Adopt independent terminal pairing and admin safe navigation while preserving staging shift guards.

user_approved_decisions.question_asked: How should Always Available interact with stock and Storefront?
user_approved_decisions.rationale: Adopt an explicit POS-only stock exemption while preserving Inventory ownership and Storefront separation.

feature_areas.intent: Add independent terminal possession proof and shift-safe administrator navigation without creating a second user credential authority.
master_behaviors_preserved: DGFY membership remains primary identity and company access.
Open-shift checks continue to protect transactional actions.
Multiple terminals may remain bound to one location.
Current POS permissions and terminal location policy remain authoritative.

tests: npm --prefix backend test -- --runInBand --runTestsByPath tests/posTerminalPairingService.test.js tests/posTerminalPairingUseCase.test.js tests/posTerminalPairingCookie.test.js
rendered_evidence: Desktop, tablet, and mobile terminal pairing, admin no-shift, and cashier-restriction evidence is required before merge approval.
production_evidence_required: No production action in this PR; later deployment must prove exact deployed SHA and pairing-secret configuration.

feature_areas.intent: Allow explicitly configured POS items to sell at zero stock without weakening stock controls for any other item.

rendered_evidence: Rendered item setup and POS catalog evidence plus read-only stock-movement proof is required before merge approval.
production_evidence_required: Later deployment must prove exempt lines create no Inventory movement while normal lines still do.

feature_areas.intent: Preserve current staging DGFY access, fiscal/compliance, location, shift, Inventory, Storefront, and release-governance behavior.

rendered_evidence: Human UAT must confirm current checkout, receipt, history, location, and DGFY access behavior is retained.
production_evidence_required: No deployment is authorized by this manifest.

feature_areas.intent: Reject unsafe or unrelated PR #25 scope.
feature_areas.rejection_reason: Tenant-local cashier credentials conflict with ADR 0028; generated, local-only, mobile, Storefront, onboarding, and unrelated changes are outside this adoption.
